title: YouCoded name and icons — round 9: fonts on real surfaces, yc, and the marketing slate

steps.path: Setup screen, site footer, lockups, the "yc" initials
steps.headline: Which fonts do you like for "youcoded" and "yc"? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Each board shows one font on the first-launch setup screen (with the tagline), the site footer, the icon + name lockups and the initials. Only the font changes between boards.

variants.summary: Lighter, airier geometric; calm on technical pages.

steps.path: Everything made once the font and icon are chosen
steps.headline: Which pieces should the full marketing slate include? Pick as many as you want.
steps.today: There are no shared marketing materials: the site, the app and any posts each style the name and mascot their own way.
steps.problem: The style rules and every piece depend on which font and icon you choose, so building them before you choose would mean redoing all of it.
steps.proposal: After you pick a font and icon above, the next round is a brand standards sheet (how to write the full name and "yc", colours, spacing, do and don't) plus whichever of these pieces you choose, all built from that sheet.

options.label: Profile pictures
pros: One square image for every social account, GitHub and Discord.
cons: Needs a version that works as a circle crop.

options.label: Link preview card
pros: The picture that shows when someone shares youcoded.ai in a chat or post.
Shown thousands of times for free.
cons: One more image to keep up to date when the site changes.

options.label: Social banners
pros: Header images for X, LinkedIn, YouTube and GitHub.
Makes every profile look like one brand.
cons: Each site crops differently, so it is several sizes of one design.

options.label: Launch / announcement graphics
pros: Ready-made templates for "new version" and "new feature" posts.
Future announcements take minutes, not a design session.
cons: Only useful if you post updates regularly.

options.label: Download page and store screenshots frame
pros: A consistent frame around app screenshots for the site and app stores.
cons: Needs fresh screenshots whenever the app's look changes.

options.label: Slide template
pros: Title, section and content slides in the brand's style for talks and pitches.
cons: Only worth it if you present YouCoded to people.

options.label: Sticker sheet
pros: Mascot faces, "yc" and the name as stickers, for laptops and events.
The mascot is made for this.
cons: Printed stickers cost money to order.

options.label: T-shirt and merch mockups
pros: Shows the brand on a shirt, mug and tote.
cons: Purely for fun or events unless you plan to sell or give them away.
